## Resumo
An action-list modal presented as the live hero of a product page for the placeholder brand 'ModalDesign' (a prompt-to-UI modal-recipe kit). The page opens on a clean white + slate-ink system with a single deep-teal accent, and the action-list dialog is the anchored hero centerpiece: a max-w-[420px] white rounded-2xl card with a centered bold title 'Choose an action', a vertical stack of FOUR action rows (each a circular icon + a label + a one-line description), with the 3rd row highlighted (teal tint + ring + filled teal icon + a return-key kbd and right chevron) as the likeliest choice, and a footer with a full-width Cancel plus a corner close button. Around the modal: a sticky frosted nav, a two-column hero (a status chip + a black headline with a teal highlight-marker underline + a lead + two CTAs + a keyboard-ready / responsive / WCAG-AA check row, beside the live modal floated over a dot-grid with a teal glow), an uppercase trust strip, a four-card 'Anatomy' band (Title / Action rows / Affordance / The way out), a full-bleed dark teal-950 'Patterns' band (three when-to-use cards), a 'Design tokens' band pairing a swatch list with a three-state row spec (rest / selected / disabled), a 'The prompt' CTA band with a dark teal-950 prompt.txt code panel, and a footer. The system is white-on-slate with a single reserved teal accent. Built on Inter, Solar icons via Iconify.

## Estilo Visual
Use a clean white + slate-ink design system with a single deep-teal accent. EXACT palette tokens (Tailwind config): a 'teal' ramp { 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1, 200 #99f6e4, 300 #5eead4, 400 #2dd4bf, 500 #14b8a6, 600 #0d9488, 700 #0f766e, 800 #115e59, 900 #134e4a, 950 #042f2e } and an 'ink' (slate) ramp { 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #020617 }. Body background ink-50 #f8fafc; default text ink-900 #0f172a. Selection: background #99f6e4 (teal-200), color #042f2e (teal-950). Discipline rule: the ink/slate ramp carries every surface and all text; the teal ramp is RESERVED for intent only (the brand 'Design' suffix + logo tile bg-teal-700, primary CTAs bg-teal-700 hover bg-teal-800, the highlighted action row's bg-teal-50 + ring-teal-200 + filled bg-teal-700 icon + teal chevron + teal kbd, uppercase eyebrows text-teal-700, check icons text-teal-600, the full-bleed teal-950 'Patterns' band, and the teal-950 prompt.txt code panel). No second accent. Font: a single Inter family via Google Fonts (wght 400;500;600;700;800;900, font-sans, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased, text-rendering optimizeLegibility). Radii: rounded-lg on controls/nav buttons, rounded-xl on rows + hero buttons, rounded-2xl on cards + the modal, rounded-3xl on the prompt CTA card, rounded-full on pills + the modal close target + icon circles. Borders: ink-200/70 hairlines on bands/cards, ink-100 inside the modal, ring-1 ring-teal-100 around default row icons, ring-1 ring-teal-200 around the active row. Effects (custom CSS): .grain = radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(15,118,110,0.10) 1px, transparent 0) at 22px 22px; .dotgrid = radial-gradient(rgba(15,118,110,0.18) 1px, transparent 1px) at 18px 18px; .teal-glow = box-shadow 0 30px 60px -22px rgba(15,118,110,0.45), 0 12px 26px -16px rgba(2,47,46,0.55); .soft-shadow = box-shadow 0 22px 48px -24px rgba(15,23,42,0.30), 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(15,23,42,0.18); .row-shadow = box-shadow 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(15,118,110,0.45). Nav link hover: .underline-grow wipes a 2px linear-gradient(#0f766e,#0f766e) underline from 0% to 100% width over .3s. Motion: a .reveal utility (opacity 0 + translateY(18px) -> opacity 1 + none over .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) toggled by an IntersectionObserver at threshold 0.12 with optional transition-delay; anatomy cards hover -translate-y-1 + hover:border-teal-200; default rows hover:bg-ink-50, the active row hover:bg-teal-100/70. Type scale: display H1 clamp 40px -> 54px -> 60px font-black leading-[1.04] tracking-[-0.03em]; section H2 30px -> 38px font-black tracking-[-0.02em]; eyebrows 12.5px font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]; trust strip 12.5px uppercase tracking-[0.14em]. Icons are Solar via Iconify (data-icon='solar:*'), teal-700 or ink, plus ri:twitter-x-fill / ri:github-fill in the footer.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky frosted nav
A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-ink-50/80 backdrop-blur-xl">` wrapping a `mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-5 sm:px-8` row. Left: a brand lockup = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg bg-teal-700 tile holding a white Solar solar:layers-minimalistic-bold (18px) with shadow-sm, beside a 15px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Modal' (ink-900) + a teal-700 'Design'. Center (hidden below md, md:flex): four 13.5px font-medium ink-600 .underline-grow links (Anatomy, Patterns, Tokens, Prompt) that hover to ink-900. Right: a 'Copy prompt' text link (hidden below sm, sm:inline-block; rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900) + a primary pill 'Open in canvas' (inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-teal-700 px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm, hover bg-teal-800, trailing solar:arrow-right-up-linear 15px).

### Full-bleed hero (copy + live modal)
A `section relative overflow-hidden border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-ink-50 to-ink-100` with a `.grain pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-60` overlay and two decorative teal blur orbs (`-left-40 top-10 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-teal-200/40 blur-3xl` and `-right-32 bottom-0 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-teal-300/30 blur-3xl`). Inner `relative mx-auto grid max-w-6xl items-center gap-12 px-5 py-16 sm:px-8 sm:py-20 lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr] lg:py-24`. LEFT (.reveal): an eyebrow chip (inline-flex rounded-full border border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-teal-800 with a solar:list-check-bold 14px + 'Action list dialog · prompt library'); an `mt-6 text-[40px] font-black leading-[1.04] tracking-[-0.03em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[54px] lg:text-[60px]` two-line headline 'One dialog,' / 'every next move.' where the second line sits in a relative inline-block with an absolute teal highlight-marker bar behind it (`absolute inset-x-0 bottom-1 z-0 h-3.5 bg-teal-200/70`); an `mt-6 max-w-md text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead 'A focused action-list modal: a clear title, a vertical stack of choices with icons and a line of context each, and a calm way out. Built for the moment your user has to pick.'; an `mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3` CTA pair — a primary 'Copy the prompt' (inline-flex rounded-xl bg-teal-700 px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm, hover bg-teal-800, leading solar:copy-bold 17px) + a ghost 'See the anatomy' (rounded-xl border border-ink-300 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-700, hover border-ink-400 + bg-ink-50, trailing solar:arrow-down-linear 15px); then an `mt-9 flex items-center gap-6 text-[12.5px] text-ink-500` check row of three items (each a teal-600 solar:check-circle-bold 16px + label) 'Keyboard ready' / 'Responsive' / 'WCAG AA'. RIGHT (.reveal, transition-delay .12s): a `relative mx-auto w-full max-w-[420px]` wrapper holding the live MODAL card (its anatomy is the next components), floated over a `.dotgrid pointer-events-none absolute -inset-6 -z-10 rounded-[28px] opacity-70` teal dot field.

### Trust strip (full-bleed)
A `section border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white`, inner `mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-10 gap-y-3 px-5 py-5 text-[12.5px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-500 sm:px-8` holding four facts separated by tiny dots: 'Copied 4,200+ times' · 'Inter · Teal · Slate' · 'Tailwind + Iconify' · 'Drop-in component', where each separator is a `hidden h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-ink-300 sm:block` dot (so on mobile the facts wrap without dots).

### Anatomy band (four cards)
A `section#anatomy bg-ink-50`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24`. A copy block (.reveal max-w-2xl): a teal-700 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'Anatomy' eyebrow, an `mt-3 text-[30px] font-black tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[38px]` H2 'Four parts, no clutter', and an `mt-4 text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead. Then an `mt-12 grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` of four .reveal cards (staggered transition-delay .06/.12/.18s), each a `group rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-6 soft-shadow` that hovers -translate-y-1 + hover:border-teal-200: a top row with a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 ring-1 ring-teal-100 icon tile + a faint ink-300 step number (01-04), then an `mt-5 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink-900` title + an `mt-1.5 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-500` body: (1) solar:text-bold-square-bold '01' 'Title' 'One short line that names the decision. Centered, bold, no period.'; (2) solar:list-bold '02' 'Action rows' 'Icon, label, a line of context. The likeliest choice gets the teal weight.'; (3) solar:cursor-bold '03' 'Affordance' 'A chevron on the active row signals "this continues" without a word.'; (4) solar:exit-bold '04' 'The way out' 'A full-width Cancel and a corner close. Leaving is never a trap.'

### Patterns band (full-bleed dark teal)
A `section#patterns relative overflow-hidden bg-teal-950 text-teal-50` with two blur orbs (`-right-40 -top-24 h-96 w-96 rounded-full bg-teal-700/30 blur-3xl` and `-left-32 bottom-0 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-teal-800/40 blur-3xl`). Inner `relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24`. A header (.reveal flex flex-col items-start justify-between gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-end): left a max-w-xl block (a teal-300 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'Patterns' eyebrow + an `mt-3 text-[30px] font-black tracking-[-0.02em] text-white sm:text-[38px]` H2 'When to reach for it' + an `mt-4 text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-teal-100/80` lead); right a ghost pill 'Get the prompt' (inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-xl border border-teal-700 bg-teal-900/50 px-4 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-teal-100, hover bg-teal-800, + solar:arrow-right-linear 15px). Then an `mt-12 grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3` of three .reveal cards (`rounded-2xl border border-teal-800/70 bg-teal-900/40 p-6 backdrop-blur`, staggered .08/.16s), each a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl bg-teal-700/60 text-teal-100 icon tile + an `mt-5 text-[17px] font-bold text-white` title + an `mt-2 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-teal-100/75` body: (1) solar:share-circle-bold 'Connect / link' 'Pick a provider, wallet, or integration. The original action-list job.'; (2) solar:add-square-bold 'Create new' 'From prompt, template, or import. One tap into the right starting point.'; (3) solar:settings-bold 'Triage a task' 'Route an item: approve, snooze, assign. Short labels, fast scan.'

### Design tokens band (swatches + row spec)
A `section#tokens bg-white`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24` with a `grid gap-12 lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] lg:items-center`. LEFT (.reveal): a teal-700 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'Design tokens' eyebrow, an `mt-3 text-[30px] font-black tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[38px]` H2 'A deliberate palette', an `mt-4 max-w-md text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead 'White surfaces, deep-teal intent, slate ink. No second accent competes for attention, so the highlighted row always wins the eye.', then an `mt-8 space-y-3` swatch `<dl>` of four rows (each `flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 px-4 py-3` with a 20px swatch chip + a name in 13.5px font-semibold ink-700 and a mono 12.5px ink-500 value): Surface #f8fafc, Accent #0f766e, Ink #0f172a, Type 'Inter' (the type row's chip is a 20px rounded-md bg-white ring-1 ring-ink-200 holding a 10px font-bold ink-700 'Aa'). RIGHT (.reveal, transition-delay .1s): a 'Row spec' mini-preview = a `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 p-6 soft-shadow sm:p-8` card with a 12px uppercase tracking-[0.14em] ink-400 label ('Row spec' + a teal-600 solar:ruler-pen-bold 15px) over a `space-y-3` stack of three row states (see the next component).

### The prompt CTA band + footer
A `section#prompt border-t border-ink-200/70 bg-ink-50`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24` holding a `.reveal overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-ink-200 bg-white soft-shadow` card split `grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr]`. LEFT half (`flex flex-col justify-center p-8 sm:p-12`): a teal-700 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'The prompt' eyebrow, an `mt-3 text-[28px] font-black leading-tight tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[34px]` H2 'Build it on the canvas in one line', an `mt-4 max-w-sm text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead, then an `mt-7 flex flex-wrap gap-3` CTA pair — a primary 'Copy prompt' (rounded-xl bg-teal-700 px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm, hover bg-teal-800, leading solar:copy-bold 17px) + a ghost 'Live preview' (rounded-xl border border-ink-300 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-700, hover bg-ink-50, leading solar:eye-bold 17px). RIGHT half (`relative border-t border-ink-200 bg-teal-950 p-8 sm:p-10 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0`): a header row ('prompt.txt' in font-mono 11.5px uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-teal-300 + a solar:document-text-bold 16px text-teal-400/70) over a font-mono 13.5px leading-relaxed text-teal-100/90 prompt paragraph with teal-400/teal-300 syntax highlights describing the modal. FOOTER: a `border-t border-ink-200/70 bg-white` block, inner `mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col items-center justify-between gap-4 px-5 py-8 sm:flex-row sm:px-8` — a brand lockup (28px h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-teal-700 tile + white solar:layers-minimalistic-bold 15px + a 14px font-extrabold 'Modal' + teal-700 'Design'), a 12.5px ink-500 tagline 'Action list dialog · a prompt-library pattern · 2026', and a 4-icon social row (ri:twitter-x-fill, ri:github-fill, solar:book-bold) in ink-400 that hover to teal-700.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
The signature component, shown live in the hero: a `<div class="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white teal-glow">` (max-w-[420px], floated over a teal .dotgrid), mapping to three stacked zones. ZONE 1 — HEADER: a `relative flex items-center justify-center border-b border-ink-100 px-6 pb-4 pt-5` row with a centered 17px font-bold tracking-tight ink-900 title 'Choose an action' and an absolute-positioned close button (`absolute right-5 top-4 grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-ink-400`, hover bg-ink-100 + text-ink-700, solar:close-circle-linear 20px, aria-label 'Close'). ZONE 2 — ACTION LIST: a `px-3 py-2` stack of four full-width button rows, each `group flex w-full items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-left` with a 40px (h-10 w-10) circular icon + a min-w-0 flex-1 label block (a 14.5px font-semibold title over a 12.5px text-ink-500 truncate description). Three default rows (hover:bg-ink-50, icon = bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 ring-1 ring-teal-100): (1) solar:magic-stick-3-bold 'Generate from prompt' / 'Describe it, get a full layout'; (2) solar:gallery-add-bold 'Start from a template' / '120+ ready dialog patterns'; (4) is the MUTED 'More options' row (icon = bg-ink-100 text-ink-500 ring-1 ring-ink-200, solar:menu-dots-bold) / 'Blank canvas, code, more'. The 3rd row is the HIGHLIGHTED / selected row = `bg-teal-50 ring-1 ring-teal-200 row-shadow` (hover bg-teal-100/70) with a FILLED icon (bg-teal-700 text-white solar:import-bold), a teal-900 title 'Import existing design' + a teal-700/80 description 'Paste a Figma or image ref', and a trailing affordance cluster (on sm+: a return-key kbd `rounded-md border border-teal-300 bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-teal-700` showing the ↵ glyph + a teal-700 solar:arrow-right-linear 18px chevron; on mobile that cluster collapses to a single teal chevron, sm:flex / sm:hidden). ZONE 3 — FOOTER: a `border-t border-ink-100 px-6 py-4` block holding a full-width 'Cancel' button (rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white py-2.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-600, hover bg-ink-50 + text-ink-900).

### Componente
The keystone of the dialog: the 3rd of four rows, styled to be unmissable as the likeliest choice. `group flex w-full items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-50 px-3 py-3 text-left ring-1 ring-teal-200 row-shadow` (hover:bg-teal-100/70). Its icon is the only FILLED circle in the list (`grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-teal-700 text-white` with solar:import-bold 20px), vs the others' tinted bg-teal-50 / ink-100 circles. Its label uses teal ink (a teal-900 14.5px font-semibold 'Import existing design' over a teal-700/80 12.5px 'Paste a Figma or image ref'). It carries a trailing affordance the other rows lack: on sm+ a `hidden shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 sm:flex` cluster of a return-key kbd (`rounded-md border border-teal-300 bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-teal-700` rendering the ↵ / ↵ glyph) + a teal-700 solar:arrow-right-linear 18px chevron; on mobile a single `sm:hidden` teal-700 chevron. The row-shadow (0 14px 30px -16px rgba(15,118,110,0.45)) lifts it off the white card. Together the tint + ring + filled icon + teal text + kbd + chevron make it the visual anchor without a separate primary button.

### Componente
The tokens band's right-column teaching card, documenting the three row states inside a `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 p-6 soft-shadow sm:p-8` panel (a 'Row spec' uppercase label + solar:ruler-pen-bold over a space-y-3 stack). REST: `flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-4 py-3` with a bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 ring-teal-100 solar:widget-2-bold circle, a 14px font-semibold ink-900 'Default state' over a 12px ink-500 '48px target · 14px gap', and a mono 'rest' chip (rounded-md bg-ink-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] ink-500). SELECTED: `flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-50 px-4 py-3 ring-1 ring-teal-200` with a FILLED bg-teal-700 text-white solar:check-circle-bold circle, a teal-900 'Selected state' over a teal-700/80 'ring + filled icon + chevron', and a trailing teal-700 solar:arrow-right-linear 17px chevron. DISABLED: `flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-ink-300 bg-white px-4 py-3` with a bg-ink-100 text-ink-400 ring-ink-200 solar:lock-keyhole-bold circle, a muted ink-400 'Disabled state' over an ink-400 'muted ink · no shadow', and a mono 'off' chip (ink-400). This makes the modal's interaction model legible as a reusable spec.

### Componente
The CTA band's right half: a `relative border-t border-ink-200 bg-teal-950 p-8 sm:p-10 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0` dark panel that reads like a code editor. A header row (`mb-4 flex items-center justify-between`) pairs a font-mono 11.5px uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-teal-300 'prompt.txt' filename with a text-teal-400/70 solar:document-text-bold 16px glyph. Below, a `font-mono text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-teal-100/90` paragraph states the actual buildable prompt with key tokens syntax-highlighted in teal-400 (the verb 'Design') and teal-300 (the quoted title '"Choose an action"', '4 rows', '3rd row', 'Cancel', the accent hex '#0f766e'): 'Design a centered action-list modal on a dimmed backdrop. White rounded card, a bold centered title "Choose an action", then a vertical list of 4 rows: each row has a circular icon, a label, and a one-line description. Highlight the 3rd row with a teal tint, ring, filled icon, and a right chevron. End with a full-width Cancel. Accent #0f766e, ink slate, Inter.'

### Componente
Two signature type touches. The hero headline 'every next move.' sits in a `relative inline-block` with the text in a `relative z-10` span over an absolute teal highlight-marker bar (`absolute inset-x-0 bottom-1 z-0 h-3.5 bg-teal-200/70`), so the phrase reads as if swiped with a teal highlighter. The nav links use an `.underline-grow` utility = a background-image linear-gradient(#0f766e,#0f766e) at background-size 0% 2px, background-position 0 100%, that transitions background-size to 100% 2px on hover (a 2px teal underline that wipes in left-to-right over .3s ease).

THE CORE DISCIPLINE (the point of this item): the slate-ink ramp carries every surface and all text, and a single deep-teal accent (#0f766e) is RESERVED for intent only — the brand 'Design' suffix + logo tile, primary CTAs (bg-teal-700 hover bg-teal-800), the highlighted action row (bg-teal-50 + ring-teal-200 + filled bg-teal-700 icon + teal chevron + teal kbd), uppercase eyebrows (text-teal-700/teal-300), check icons (text-teal-600), the dark teal-950 Patterns band and the teal-950 prompt panel — so no second accent competes and the likeliest choice in the list is unmissable. Radii: rounded-lg controls, rounded-xl rows + hero buttons, rounded-2xl cards + the modal, rounded-3xl on the prompt CTA card, rounded-full pills + the modal close + icon circles. Effects (custom CSS): .grain (radial teal/0.10 1px dots at 22px), .dotgrid (radial teal/0.18 1px dots at 18px), .teal-glow (0 30px 60px -22px rgba(15,118,110,0.45), 0 12px 26px -16px rgba(2,47,46,0.55)), .soft-shadow (0 22px 48px -24px rgba(15,23,42,0.30), 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(15,23,42,0.18)), .row-shadow (0 14px 30px -16px rgba(15,118,110,0.45)); two faint teal blur-3xl orbs on the hero and Patterns bands; a frosted sticky nav (bg-ink-50/80 + backdrop-blur-xl). Motion: a .reveal utility (opacity 0 + translateY(18px) -> in over .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) driven by an IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.12, unobserve once shown) with staggered transition-delays; an .underline-grow nav-link hover (a 2px teal underline wiping 0% -> 100% over .3s); anatomy cards hover -translate-y-1 + hover:border-teal-200; default rows hover:bg-ink-50, the active row hover:bg-teal-100/70; ::selection paints teal-200-on-teal-950. Layout: a sticky top-0 z-50 frosted nav over a shared mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 sm:px-8 container — a full-bleed gradient hero (copy column + the live action-list modal floated over a teal .dotgrid in a .teal-glow card), a white uppercase trust strip, a bg-ink-50 four-card Anatomy band, a full-bleed dark teal-950 Patterns band (three cards), a white Design-tokens band (a swatch <dl> + a three-state Row-spec preview), a bg-ink-50 'The prompt' CTA band (a rounded-3xl split card: white copy + a dark teal-950 prompt.txt panel), and a white footer. Responsive reflow: the hero lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr] collapses to one column (the modal stacks under the copy), the anatomy grid steps sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4, the patterns grid steps lg:grid-cols-3, the tokens lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] + prompt lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr] collapse to one column (the prompt code panel moving below the copy with border-t replacing the lg:border-l), the nav center links hide (md:flex) and the 'Copy prompt' text link hides (sm:inline-block) while the teal 'Open in canvas' pill persists, the trust-strip dot separators hide (sm:block), and inside the modal the active row's kbd+chevron cluster collapses to a single chevron (sm:flex / sm:hidden). Accessibility intent: aria-label 'Close' on the modal close button, WCAG-AA contrast claimed in the hero check row, full-width keyboard-reachable button rows, and a return-key kbd hint on the active row.

structured.summary: An action-list modal presented as the live hero of a product page for the placeholder brand 'ModalDesign' (a prompt-to-UI modal-recipe kit). The page opens on a clean white + slate-ink system with a single deep-teal accent, and the action-list dialog is the anchored hero centerpiece: a max-w-[420px] white rounded-2xl card with a centered bold title 'Choose an action', a vertical stack of FOUR action rows (each a circular icon + a label + a one-line description), with the 3rd row highlighted (teal tint + ring + filled teal icon + a return-key kbd and right chevron) as the likeliest choice, and a footer with a full-width Cancel plus a corner close button. Around the modal: a sticky frosted nav, a two-column hero (a status chip + a black headline with a teal highlight-marker underline + a lead + two CTAs + a keyboard-ready / responsive / WCAG-AA check row, beside the live modal floated over a dot-grid with a teal glow), an uppercase trust strip, a four-card 'Anatomy' band (Title / Action rows / Affordance / The way out), a full-bleed dark teal-950 'Patterns' band (three when-to-use cards), a 'Design tokens' band pairing a swatch list with a three-state row spec (rest / selected / disabled), a 'The prompt' CTA band with a dark teal-950 prompt.txt code panel, and a footer. The system is white-on-slate with a single reserved teal accent. Built on Inter, Solar icons via Iconify.

style.description: A clean, calm, product-grade aesthetic built to make a generated action-list dialog feel deliberate rather than default. The mood is bright and airy: near-white slate surfaces (ink-50 #f8fafc) for the body and light bands, pure white for cards and the modal, with a single near-black slate for ink and a deep-teal accent that does ALL the work. Color is strictly disciplined: the slate 'ink' ramp (#f8fafc -> #0f172a) carries every surface and all text, and a single teal ramp (teal-50 #f0fdfa / teal-700 #0f766e / teal-950 #042f2e) is RESERVED for intent only (the brand 'Design' suffix, the logo tile, primary CTAs, the highlighted action row's tint + ring + filled icon + chevron + kbd, eyebrow labels, check icons, the dark 'Patterns' band and the dark prompt panel). No second accent competes, so the highlighted row always wins the eye. The hero floats the modal over a teal dotgrid (radial teal/0.18 dots at 18px) inside a soft teal-glow shadow (0 30px 60px -22px rgba(15,118,110,0.45) + 0 12px 26px -16px rgba(2,47,46,0.55)), with two faint teal blur orbs and a grain dot texture (radial teal/0.10 dots at 22px) behind it. Surfaces are hairlined with ink-200/70 borders, generous rounding (rounded-lg controls, rounded-xl rows + buttons, rounded-2xl cards + the modal, rounded-3xl on the prompt CTA card, rounded-full pills + the close target), and a soft-shadow on cards (0 22px 48px -24px rgba(15,23,42,0.30)) plus a row-shadow on the highlighted row (0 14px 30px -16px rgba(15,118,110,0.45)). Type is a single Inter family across weights 400-900: black (900) display headlines with tight tracking (-0.03em), bold section H2s, semibold labels and row titles, and uppercase widely-tracked (0.14-0.16em) eyebrows + trust-strip text. The headline carries a teal highlight-marker bar behind 'every next move.'; nav links use an .underline-grow that wipes a 2px teal underline in on hover. Motion is restrained and intentional: a .reveal utility fades + lifts sections in on scroll (IntersectionObserver), anatomy cards lift -translate-y-1 and gain a teal border on hover, rows tint to ink-50 (or teal-100/70 for the active row) on hover. The whole point: teal is the only accent, so it reads as a single deliberate 'intent' color and the likeliest choice in the list is unmissable.
style.prompt: Use a clean white + slate-ink design system with a single deep-teal accent. EXACT palette tokens (Tailwind config): a 'teal' ramp { 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1, 200 #99f6e4, 300 #5eead4, 400 #2dd4bf, 500 #14b8a6, 600 #0d9488, 700 #0f766e, 800 #115e59, 900 #134e4a, 950 #042f2e } and an 'ink' (slate) ramp { 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #020617 }. Body background ink-50 #f8fafc; default text ink-900 #0f172a. Selection: background #99f6e4 (teal-200), color #042f2e (teal-950). Discipline rule: the ink/slate ramp carries every surface and all text; the teal ramp is RESERVED for intent only (the brand 'Design' suffix + logo tile bg-teal-700, primary CTAs bg-teal-700 hover bg-teal-800, the highlighted action row's bg-teal-50 + ring-teal-200 + filled bg-teal-700 icon + teal chevron + teal kbd, uppercase eyebrows text-teal-700, check icons text-teal-600, the full-bleed teal-950 'Patterns' band, and the teal-950 prompt.txt code panel). No second accent. Font: a single Inter family via Google Fonts (wght 400;500;600;700;800;900, font-sans, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased, text-rendering optimizeLegibility). Radii: rounded-lg on controls/nav buttons, rounded-xl on rows + hero buttons, rounded-2xl on cards + the modal, rounded-3xl on the prompt CTA card, rounded-full on pills + the modal close target + icon circles. Borders: ink-200/70 hairlines on bands/cards, ink-100 inside the modal, ring-1 ring-teal-100 around default row icons, ring-1 ring-teal-200 around the active row. Effects (custom CSS): .grain = radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(15,118,110,0.10) 1px, transparent 0) at 22px 22px; .dotgrid = radial-gradient(rgba(15,118,110,0.18) 1px, transparent 1px) at 18px 18px; .teal-glow = box-shadow 0 30px 60px -22px rgba(15,118,110,0.45), 0 12px 26px -16px rgba(2,47,46,0.55); .soft-shadow = box-shadow 0 22px 48px -24px rgba(15,23,42,0.30), 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(15,23,42,0.18); .row-shadow = box-shadow 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(15,118,110,0.45). Nav link hover: .underline-grow wipes a 2px linear-gradient(#0f766e,#0f766e) underline from 0% to 100% width over .3s. Motion: a .reveal utility (opacity 0 + translateY(18px) -> opacity 1 + none over .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) toggled by an IntersectionObserver at threshold 0.12 with optional transition-delay; anatomy cards hover -translate-y-1 + hover:border-teal-200; default rows hover:bg-ink-50, the active row hover:bg-teal-100/70. Type scale: display H1 clamp 40px -> 54px -> 60px font-black leading-[1.04] tracking-[-0.03em]; section H2 30px -> 38px font-black tracking-[-0.02em]; eyebrows 12.5px font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]; trust strip 12.5px uppercase tracking-[0.14em]. Icons are Solar via Iconify (data-icon='solar:*'), teal-700 or ink, plus ri:twitter-x-fill / ri:github-fill in the footer.

layout_and_structure.description: A single vertically-scrolling product page on a shared mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 sm:px-8 container, with the action-list modal as the anchored hero centerpiece (shown live, in context, not floated on a blank artboard). Order: (1) a sticky top-0 z-50 frosted nav (bg-ink-50/80 + backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-ink-200/70); (2) a full-bleed hero on a from-white via-ink-50 to-ink-100 gradient with a .grain overlay and two teal blur orbs, holding a two-column grid (lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr]) — left a copy column (eyebrow chip + a black headline with a teal highlight-marker bar + a lead + two CTAs + a three-item check row), right the live action-list MODAL floated over a teal .dotgrid inside a .teal-glow card; (3) a white full-bleed uppercase trust strip (centered dot-separated facts); (4) a bg-ink-50 'Anatomy' band with a copy block + a four-card responsive grid (sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4); (5) a full-bleed dark teal-950 'Patterns' band (eyebrow + H2 + a 'Get the prompt' pill, over a three-card lg:grid-cols-3 grid of translucent teal-900/40 cards) with two teal blur orbs; (6) a white 'Design tokens' band with a two-column grid (lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]) pairing a swatch <dl> with a 'Row spec' mini-preview card showing three row states; (7) a bg-ink-50 'The prompt' CTA band holding a rounded-3xl card split lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr] into a white copy half (eyebrow + H2 + lead + Copy/Preview CTAs) and a dark teal-950 prompt.txt code half; then a white footer. It reflows cleanly to mobile: the hero two-column grid collapses to one column (the modal stacks under the copy), the anatomy grid steps 1 -> 2 -> 4, the patterns grid steps 1 -> 3, the tokens + prompt grids collapse to one column (the prompt code panel moves below the copy with border-t instead of border-l), the nav center links hide (md:flex) and the 'Copy prompt' text link hides (sm:inline-block) while the teal 'Open in canvas' pill persists, the trust-strip dot separators hide on small screens (sm:block), and inside the modal the active row's kbd+chevron cluster collapses to a single chevron (sm:flex / sm:hidden).

prompts.prompt: A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-ink-50/80 backdrop-blur-xl">` wrapping a `mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-5 sm:px-8` row. Left: a brand lockup = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg bg-teal-700 tile holding a white Solar solar:layers-minimalistic-bold (18px) with shadow-sm, beside a 15px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Modal' (ink-900) + a teal-700 'Design'. Center (hidden below md, md:flex): four 13.5px font-medium ink-600 .underline-grow links (Anatomy, Patterns, Tokens, Prompt) that hover to ink-900. Right: a 'Copy prompt' text link (hidden below sm, sm:inline-block; rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900) + a primary pill 'Open in canvas' (inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-teal-700 px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm, hover bg-teal-800, trailing solar:arrow-right-up-linear 15px).

A `section relative overflow-hidden border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-ink-50 to-ink-100` with a `.grain pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-60` overlay and two decorative teal blur orbs (`-left-40 top-10 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-teal-200/40 blur-3xl` and `-right-32 bottom-0 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-teal-300/30 blur-3xl`). Inner `relative mx-auto grid max-w-6xl items-center gap-12 px-5 py-16 sm:px-8 sm:py-20 lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr] lg:py-24`. LEFT (.reveal): an eyebrow chip (inline-flex rounded-full border border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-teal-800 with a solar:list-check-bold 14px + 'Action list dialog · prompt library'); an `mt-6 text-[40px] font-black leading-[1.04] tracking-[-0.03em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[54px] lg:text-[60px]` two-line headline 'One dialog,' / 'every next move.' where the second line sits in a relative inline-block with an absolute teal highlight-marker bar behind it (`absolute inset-x-0 bottom-1 z-0 h-3.5 bg-teal-200/70`); an `mt-6 max-w-md text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead 'A focused action-list modal: a clear title, a vertical stack of choices with icons and a line of context each, and a calm way out. Built for the moment your user has to pick.'; an `mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3` CTA pair — a primary 'Copy the prompt' (inline-flex rounded-xl bg-teal-700 px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm, hover bg-teal-800, leading solar:copy-bold 17px) + a ghost 'See the anatomy' (rounded-xl border border-ink-300 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-700, hover border-ink-400 + bg-ink-50, trailing solar:arrow-down-linear 15px); then an `mt-9 flex items-center gap-6 text-[12.5px] text-ink-500` check row of three items (each a teal-600 solar:check-circle-bold 16px + label) 'Keyboard ready' / 'Responsive' / 'WCAG AA'. RIGHT (.reveal, transition-delay .12s): a `relative mx-auto w-full max-w-[420px]` wrapper holding the live MODAL card (its anatomy is the next components), floated over a `.dotgrid pointer-events-none absolute -inset-6 -z-10 rounded-[28px] opacity-70` teal dot field.

A `section border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white`, inner `mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-10 gap-y-3 px-5 py-5 text-[12.5px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-500 sm:px-8` holding four facts separated by tiny dots: 'Copied 4,200+ times' · 'Inter · Teal · Slate' · 'Tailwind + Iconify' · 'Drop-in component', where each separator is a `hidden h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-ink-300 sm:block` dot (so on mobile the facts wrap without dots).

A `section#anatomy bg-ink-50`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24`. A copy block (.reveal max-w-2xl): a teal-700 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'Anatomy' eyebrow, an `mt-3 text-[30px] font-black tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[38px]` H2 'Four parts, no clutter', and an `mt-4 text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead. Then an `mt-12 grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` of four .reveal cards (staggered transition-delay .06/.12/.18s), each a `group rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-6 soft-shadow` that hovers -translate-y-1 + hover:border-teal-200: a top row with a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 ring-1 ring-teal-100 icon tile + a faint ink-300 step number (01-04), then an `mt-5 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink-900` title + an `mt-1.5 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-500` body: (1) solar:text-bold-square-bold '01' 'Title' 'One short line that names the decision. Centered, bold, no period.'; (2) solar:list-bold '02' 'Action rows' 'Icon, label, a line of context. The likeliest choice gets the teal weight.'; (3) solar:cursor-bold '03' 'Affordance' 'A chevron on the active row signals "this continues" without a word.'; (4) solar:exit-bold '04' 'The way out' 'A full-width Cancel and a corner close. Leaving is never a trap.'

A `section#patterns relative overflow-hidden bg-teal-950 text-teal-50` with two blur orbs (`-right-40 -top-24 h-96 w-96 rounded-full bg-teal-700/30 blur-3xl` and `-left-32 bottom-0 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-teal-800/40 blur-3xl`). Inner `relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24`. A header (.reveal flex flex-col items-start justify-between gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-end): left a max-w-xl block (a teal-300 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'Patterns' eyebrow + an `mt-3 text-[30px] font-black tracking-[-0.02em] text-white sm:text-[38px]` H2 'When to reach for it' + an `mt-4 text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-teal-100/80` lead); right a ghost pill 'Get the prompt' (inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-xl border border-teal-700 bg-teal-900/50 px-4 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-teal-100, hover bg-teal-800, + solar:arrow-right-linear 15px). Then an `mt-12 grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3` of three .reveal cards (`rounded-2xl border border-teal-800/70 bg-teal-900/40 p-6 backdrop-blur`, staggered .08/.16s), each a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl bg-teal-700/60 text-teal-100 icon tile + an `mt-5 text-[17px] font-bold text-white` title + an `mt-2 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-teal-100/75` body: (1) solar:share-circle-bold 'Connect / link' 'Pick a provider, wallet, or integration. The original action-list job.'; (2) solar:add-square-bold 'Create new' 'From prompt, template, or import. One tap into the right starting point.'; (3) solar:settings-bold 'Triage a task' 'Route an item: approve, snooze, assign. Short labels, fast scan.'

A `section#tokens bg-white`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24` with a `grid gap-12 lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] lg:items-center`. LEFT (.reveal): a teal-700 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'Design tokens' eyebrow, an `mt-3 text-[30px] font-black tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[38px]` H2 'A deliberate palette', an `mt-4 max-w-md text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead 'White surfaces, deep-teal intent, slate ink. No second accent competes for attention, so the highlighted row always wins the eye.', then an `mt-8 space-y-3` swatch `<dl>` of four rows (each `flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 px-4 py-3` with a 20px swatch chip + a name in 13.5px font-semibold ink-700 and a mono 12.5px ink-500 value): Surface #f8fafc, Accent #0f766e, Ink #0f172a, Type 'Inter' (the type row's chip is a 20px rounded-md bg-white ring-1 ring-ink-200 holding a 10px font-bold ink-700 'Aa'). RIGHT (.reveal, transition-delay .1s): a 'Row spec' mini-preview = a `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 p-6 soft-shadow sm:p-8` card with a 12px uppercase tracking-[0.14em] ink-400 label ('Row spec' + a teal-600 solar:ruler-pen-bold 15px) over a `space-y-3` stack of three row states (see the next component).

prompts.prompt: A `section#prompt border-t border-ink-200/70 bg-ink-50`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-24` holding a `.reveal overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-ink-200 bg-white soft-shadow` card split `grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr]`. LEFT half (`flex flex-col justify-center p-8 sm:p-12`): a teal-700 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] 'The prompt' eyebrow, an `mt-3 text-[28px] font-black leading-tight tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink-900 sm:text-[34px]` H2 'Build it on the canvas in one line', an `mt-4 max-w-sm text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` lead, then an `mt-7 flex flex-wrap gap-3` CTA pair — a primary 'Copy prompt' (rounded-xl bg-teal-700 px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm, hover bg-teal-800, leading solar:copy-bold 17px) + a ghost 'Live preview' (rounded-xl border border-ink-300 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-700, hover bg-ink-50, leading solar:eye-bold 17px). RIGHT half (`relative border-t border-ink-200 bg-teal-950 p-8 sm:p-10 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0`): a header row ('prompt.txt' in font-mono 11.5px uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-teal-300 + a solar:document-text-bold 16px text-teal-400/70) over a font-mono 13.5px leading-relaxed text-teal-100/90 prompt paragraph with teal-400/teal-300 syntax highlights describing the modal. special_ui_components.prompt: The signature component, shown live in the hero: a `<div class="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white teal-glow">` (max-w-[420px], floated over a teal .dotgrid), mapping to three stacked zones. ZONE 1 — HEADER: a `relative flex items-center justify-center border-b border-ink-100 px-6 pb-4 pt-5` row with a centered 17px font-bold tracking-tight ink-900 title 'Choose an action' and an absolute-positioned close button (`absolute right-5 top-4 grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-ink-400`, hover bg-ink-100 + text-ink-700, solar:close-circle-linear 20px, aria-label 'Close'). ZONE 2 — ACTION LIST: a `px-3 py-2` stack of four full-width button rows, each `group flex w-full items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-left` with a 40px (h-10 w-10) circular icon + a min-w-0 flex-1 label block (a 14.5px font-semibold title over a 12.5px text-ink-500 truncate description). Three default rows (hover:bg-ink-50, icon = bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 ring-1 ring-teal-100): (1) solar:magic-stick-3-bold 'Generate from prompt' / 'Describe it, get a full layout'; (2) solar:gallery-add-bold 'Start from a template' / '120+ ready dialog patterns'; (4) is the MUTED 'More options' row (icon = bg-ink-100 text-ink-500 ring-1 ring-ink-200, solar:menu-dots-bold) / 'Blank canvas, code, more'. The 3rd row is the HIGHLIGHTED / selected row = `bg-teal-50 ring-1 ring-teal-200 row-shadow` (hover bg-teal-100/70) with a FILLED icon (bg-teal-700 text-white solar:import-bold), a teal-900 title 'Import existing design' + a teal-700/80 description 'Paste a Figma or image ref', and a trailing affordance cluster (on sm+: a return-key kbd `rounded-md border border-teal-300 bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-teal-700` showing the ↵ glyph + a teal-700 solar:arrow-right-linear 18px chevron; on mobile that cluster collapses to a single teal chevron, sm:flex / sm:hidden). ZONE 3 — FOOTER: a `border-t border-ink-100 px-6 py-4` block holding a full-width 'Cancel' button (rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white py-2.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-600, hover bg-ink-50 + text-ink-900).

The keystone of the dialog: the 3rd of four rows, styled to be unmissable as the likeliest choice. `group flex w-full items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-50 px-3 py-3 text-left ring-1 ring-teal-200 row-shadow` (hover:bg-teal-100/70).
